South Korea announces massive AI chip investment plan

South Korea has unveiled a significant investment plan, aiming to pour over $576 billion into artificial intelligence and chip manufacturing. The initiative involves major tech companies like Samsung and SK Hynix, alongside local governments, to bolster the nation's industrial strength in the AI sector. This move is framed as a strategic race to secure global leadership in AI technology amidst regional competition.
